name: Love Makes Us Cry
description: Young people who migrated from the provinces to Istanbul and tried to survive alone; it is the story of the conflict between their conscience and their love.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Ada is a 19-year-old girl who lost her mother at a young age and never knew her father. When Yusuf returns home tired from work at midnight one night, he finds a letter written to Ada in the bag that Fırat found on the road. When the young man reads the letter, he realizes that he must deliver it to its owner and sets off without wasting any time... Yusuf's journey will change his and Ada's lives forever... However, it will not be that easy for Ada to follow her dreams; her uncle Ismail and her future fiancé Mustafa are willing to do anything to stop Ada.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Unaware of what happened to Yusuf, Ada is left alone on the ruthless streets of Istanbul. In this big city where she knows almost no one, penniless and clueless, the young woman still won't surrender to difficulties easily. She believes that Yusuf won't just leave her and will do everything she can to find him. On the other hand, Yusuf will be taken to court. Yusuf does everything he can to reach Ada and give her a message. Still, it won't be easy for the two to reunite. Moreover, Mustafa and İsmail are also after Ada. While İsmail is getting closer to Ada step by step; Yusuf is forced to stop İsmail. So what will be the price for this?

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: While everything is going well for Ada and Yusuf, neither Nalan nor İsmail are willing to accept defeat. Yusuf takes action immediately to save Ada from Mustafa and İsmail. Yusuf, who saves Ada with difficulty with help from someone he did not expect, now wants to leave Nalan and continue his life with Ada. However, this will not be as easy as he thought. In the meantime, while Ada is struggling to survive in Istanbul, she realizes that she will not be able to stay in Nagehan's house for long. While she is afraid of being left on the street in a city she does not know, she will receive the greatest help from Yusuf and Sumru.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Nalan, who was hospitalized with severe injuries, uses this incident ruthlessly with the intention of making Yusuf and Ada's love impossible. So-called; She tried to take her own life because Yusuf abandoned her. Yusuf is not suspicious of the situation, as such an incident has happened before, and he promises Nalan a lifelong commitment, even though he bleeds inside. Ada, on the other hand, unaware that she has lost Yusuf, to whom she is deeply in love, manages to get rid of Mustafa, who has come to Istanbul after her uncle and aunt, thanks to her boss Rüzgar. On the other hand, there is an assistant crisis in the house of Rüzgar's family. Ada, who wants to pay her debt of loyalty to Rüzgar, welcomes the offer with enthusiasm. How difficult can it be for the parents of an understanding and helpful person like Rüzgar?

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Thinking that Nalan has committed suicide, Yusuf has to tell Ada that he cannot leave her. Ada understands Yusuf. But separation is very difficult for both of them. Rüzgâr is by Ada's side in these difficult moments. Although Ada and Yusuf try to stay away from each other, fate brings them together frequently. This situation causes Nalan to talk to her uncle in order to push Ada away. How will this conversation reflect on Ada? Çiçek secretly takes one of Nalan's dresses for a job. However, when Nalan understands the situation, it causes great tension in the boarding house. On the other hand, Sumru and Fırat try to find a weakness in Nalan. Will Nalan's relationship with Mert be revealed?

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Ada, who sees Nalan and Mert kissing, confronts Nalan. Nalan tries to prevent Ada from telling Yusuf what she saw. While Ada is undecided whether to tell Yusuf this truth or not, a bad surprise awaits her; Mustafa has come to Istanbul. On the other hand, Nihal and Yıldırım realize a very important secret about Ada's past. Yildirim decides to tell Ada who she is. Yusuf realizes that he can no longer control his heart and decides to break up with Nalan and be with Ada. However, when he goes to talk to Ada, he is shocked by an unexpected sight.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Seeing Ada and Rüzgar together, Yusuf thinks that Ada is getting close to Rüzgar. Ada cannot make sense of Yusuf's cold and distant behavior towards her and decides to talk to him. Ada tells Yusuf why she and Rüzgar were together that night, says that she misunderstood everything and says 'I only love you'. After talking to Ada, Yusuf decides to break up with Nalan and he does. There is no longer any obstacle between him and Ada, there is no one happier than them in the world. But Nalan is not one to give up so easily. She has a plan to win Yusuf back.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Nalan's pregnancy has separated Ada and Yusuf. Yusuf returns to Nalan, but he is very unhappy; his mind and heart are with his one and only love Ada. He looks for ways to meet Ada and be with her at every opportunity. Nihal makes an agreement with Ada to provide home care services for Yıldırım after he is discharged from the hospital. Ada starts working from the Özben family home. Rüzgar is very happy about this decision. He has an opportunity to get closer to Ada. Nihal and Mert are relieved after convincing Yıldırım to keep the secret. However, something happens that they never expected.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Yusuf regrets what he said and starts to think that he was unfair to Ada. Ada hears words she never expected from Yusuf and is very hurt. Rüzgar tries to calm her down but Ada is angry with Yusuf. While Yusuf is looking for a place in Istanbul for his grandfather whose house burned down, he is also trying to make peace with Ada. After İsmail learns that Ada is the real owner of the Özben family's fortune, he makes a plan. He confronts Mert. Mert thinks of a way for İsmail to keep this secret and stay silent.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Trying to prevent Çiçek from telling Yusuf what she learned, Nalân causes her to fall down the stairs while trying to stop her. Yusuf and Ada find Çiçek and save her life. Sumru, Fırat and Hikmet rush to the hospital after learning about Çiçek's condition, who is immediately taken into surgery. On the other hand, Mert influences Wind to reveal his feelings for Ada as soon as possible and take action so that they do not lose their undeserved fortune. Ismail does not realize the trap set for him. Yusuf, who is deeply shaken after the harsh words of Rüzgar, who reveals his feelings for Ada to him, decides on another way to earn money. Wind, on the other hand, prepares to reveal his feelings to Ada.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Nalan has to find a way to prevent Çiçek from waking up, talking and giving herself away. Ada goes crazy with curiosity after the disappearance of Yusuf, who was shot on his first night on the dark roads he stepped on. Together with Fırat, she makes a great effort to find Yusuf. It turns out that Zeynel, who is about to lure Ismail into his web, is also involved in Yusuf's injury. Cevdet finds Yusuf unconscious and saves his life. Çiçek regains consciousness but does not remember what happened because she has lost her memory. Nalan is overjoyed with this news. She takes action to marry Yusuf as soon as possible. Ada, who can't find Yusuf anywhere, is very worried, but when she sees Yusuf, she is overjoyed. She forgets that she has to suppress her love for him. For a moment, they are both very happy. But this happiness doesn't last long.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Yusuf tells Ada that he will not give up on her. Ada rejects him, stating that they cannot do this for her unborn baby. Nalan, angry at what Yusuf did, provokes her grandfather against him and causes him to leave the house and leave. Yusuf goes crazy after his grandfather leaves and starts looking for him everywhere. Homeless Cevdet starts to make small touches in everyone's lives. Çiçek is discharged. Together with Fırat, they start working to expose Nalan's lies. Ismail, who decides to win Ada's favor and win her heart, starts working at Sumru's restaurant. Meanwhile, Ada, who finds Yusuf's grandfather, unwittingly takes the first step towards the end for both of them...

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: When Nalan's baby lie is revealed, Yusuf takes his breath with Ada. The couple, happy that there is no longer any obstacle between them, takes the first step to get married; Yusuf goes to ask for Ada. Nalan has no choice but to try to be with Mert. Rüzgar declares his love and when he doesn't find a response, he can't control himself and tries to kidnap Ada. While Yusuf is on the trail with Cevdet Yalçın, everyone is on the hunt for the missing Ada.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Yusuf shoots Rüzgar who kidnapped Ada. Wind files a complaint against Yusuf. Cevdet, who turns out to be Ada's father known to be dead, takes action to save Yusuf. Cemre, Cevdet's daughter from his first marriage, meets Yusuf and Ada and begins to question who they are. Cevdet Yalçın, on the other hand, threatens Nihal to reveal the horrible crime he committed in the past in order to get Rüzgar to withdraw his complaint. But Rüzgar, determined to get Ada, ignores neither his mother Nihal's plea nor Ada's begging and does not withdraw his complaint. Ismail learns that Ada was kidnapped by Rüzgar and that Yusuf shot Rüzgar and saved her. Yusuf, who is imprisoned, is seriously wounded by Wind's men, while Wind offers Ada to marry him in exchange for Yusuf's life.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Cemre brings Yusuf, whose heart stops, back to life. Ada is very impressed by Yusuf's return from death. Rüzgar, on the other hand, gets desperate to get Ada and starts to harm Fırat, Sumru, Çiçek and İsmail. While Nihal goes crazy because her past deeds will be revealed, Cevdet, who turns out to be the famous businessman Hünkar Balaban, whose face very few people have seen, is in a very difficult situation, especially when his daughter Cemre and his beloved wife Zeynep ask questions about Ada and Yusuf. Yusuf, who dreams of running away with Ada as soon as he gets out of prison while he is in the hospital, regains his freedom after Hünkar's efforts and Rüzgar withdraws his complaint. He takes action to run away with Ada. Ada, on the other hand, is stuck in the middle of a difficult decision between sacrificing herself for her loved ones and giving up her loved ones for love!

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Yusuf, who learned from Nalân that Ada was about to marry Wind, went crazy. İsmail, who is after Ada's fortune, gets a big shock when he meets Hünkâr on his way to reach Erdem's wife. Hünkar asks him to account for what he did to Ada. Yusuf, who learns that Ada has given up on him so that her loved ones will not be harmed, immediately takes action to save her from the hands of Wind. A big surprise about her father awaits Ada, who agrees to marry Wind for the life of Yusuf and her loved ones. On the other hand, Zeynep begins to question why her husband is going after the Özbens again despite his promise to her. She gets very close to learning Hünkâr's secret about Ada.
